notes: Added item search and autocomplete across inventory, shipments, invoices, and special pricing
Added scrollable main tabs and detail windows for improved usability on smaller screens
Improved Special Pricing removal controls with clearer action labels
Added editing support for open invoices, including item, quantity, and sale-type changes
Added inventory reconciliation when modifying open invoices
Added voiding support for open invoices with automatic inventory and customer credit restoration
Added built-in INTERNAL USE transactions for inventory withdrawals with no sales revenue
Added detailed shipment history with shipment viewing and inventory correction support
Redesigned the History tab to group records by invoice, shipment, internal use, and refund
Added searchable and filterable history with access to the raw inventory audit log
Added prior-invoice charge adjustments for correcting undercharged closed invoices
Added combined payment support for closing multiple open invoices for the same customer
Improved transaction, shipment, and invoice detail workflows
Various usability, audit-history, and inventory consistency improvements
